body:
<!-- Thanks for contributing! Describe your change below. -->

## Summary

Exports can now be capped to a size, so a video fits where it is going. The bitrate is computed from the duration instead of failing.

- `acme export --max-mb N` picks a bitrate that lands under N MB
- The cap leaves 5% headroom for the container

## User-facing changes

- `acme export --max-mb 10` makes a file you can attach to a GitHub PR

## Test plan

- [x] Added `test_export_respects_the_cap`
- [ ] Tried it on a 2 GB project

Fixes #470
title: Cap `acme export` at a size with --max-mb
